# Commit map of the history rewrite of 2026-11-01

Genre: proof record (not normative). On 2026-11-01 the whole history of this repository was rewritten on the owner's instruction so that no commit names a consumer product built with the tool (`AUDIT.md`, CK-A75; PROP-004 `NO-CONSUMER-PRODUCT-IN-THE-TOOL`). Every commit from the first affected one onward received a new hash; the 158 earlier commits kept theirs. A hash cited in a record written before that date - earlier sections of `AUDIT.md`, the campaign ledgers under `campaigns/`, decision records in the specifications - is an old hash: look it up in the left column. The pre-rewrite objects are not kept in this repository.

Rewritten commits: 188. Unchanged commits: 158.
